==Dialogue==
'''Tian Menglin:''' This antique item is more weathered and robust compared to other versions of the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou. It's now a historical artifact of great significance. 
'''Tian Menglin:''' But it's consistently harder to maintain than other models and requires serveral specific parts for repairs.
